fixes.explanation: No coward in this verse, friend. The note in the parentheses reads “…(that is, an idolater)…”, tucked in right after “greedy person.” That little aside slipped right past you, and I'm not judging, because I once spent a whole afternoon hunting for a spatula I was holding in my mustache. Paul is saying that greed and idolatry are tied together (Ephesians 5:5).
